name: Real MXN
oneLiner: MXNe is Brale's Mexican peso stablecoin issued in partnership with Etherfuse, backed by Etherfuse Stablebonds (CETES exposure) on Base, Solana, and Stellar.
collateral: Backed by Etherfuse CETES Stablebonds — short-duration (~7-day) Mexican federal government Treasury bills (CETES), held across regulated Mexican custodians with a majority at BBVA Mexico and held through INDEVAL; reserves segregated from Etherfuse corporate funds, issued via Brale's regulated US stack
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption through Brale onboarding, with MXNe intended to remain redeemable 1:1 for the equivalent value of Mexican pesos and usable for payments, remittances, and payroll

proofOfReserves.provider: Etherfuse third-party attestations (BHR Mexico) covering the CETES Stablebonds backing MXNe

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators; NMLS ID #2376957
genius.notes: MXNe is a Brale-issued peso stablecoin with U.S. money-transmitter context, but no GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or official application was located. Brale operates as a FinCEN-registered MSB and licensed money transmitter (NMLS #2376957). The June 2026 Visa/Brale SBC proof-of-concept on Canton Network does not change MXNe's GENIUS status. Brale has not announced a PPSI pathway election (state-qualified vs. federal nonbank) as of 2026-06-18.

mintAuthority.summary: MXNe is issued by Brale across Base (BraleToken ERC1967 proxy), Solana (SPL mint), and Stellar (issuer account); on each chain a single issuer-controlled EOA/keypair holds all mint and admin rights.

controls.label: Brale MINTER_ROLE EOA — Base
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200644, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110) on the BraleToken proxy (0x269cae7dc59803e5c596c95756faeebb6030e0af) returned true. eth_getCode confirms EOA. Same address also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. MINTER_ROLE = keccak256('MINTER_ROLE') = 0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6. Contract source confirmed as BraleToken (OpenZeppelin AccessControl + UUPS) via Blockscout.

controls.label: Brale mint authority keypair — Solana
controls.evidence: getAccountInfo on SPL mint 6zYgzrT7X2wi9a9NeMtUvUWLLmf2a8vBsbYkocYdB9wa returned mintAuthority=3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH and freezeAuthority=same. That account is owned by System Program and non-executable (regular Solana keypair/EOA).

controls.label: Brale issuer account — Stellar
controls.evidence: Stellar Horizon: issuer GCQCNWT22JDLENQAVIE6DRJGHWAQ6EX2H5ABGPV55EJUPPZM5UA7KHZR has 1 signer (self, weight=1), all thresholds=0, auth_revocable and auth_clawback_enabled set — standard single-key issuer account.

review.evidence: At Base block 47200644: BraleToken proxy 0x269cae7dc59803e5c596c95756faeebb6030e0af (ERC1967 → impl 0x2a6c613bd6288b1f7e1c02393f1cf92444eadee5, source BraleToken confirmed on Blockscout). MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE both held by EOA 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110. Solana: mintAuthority and freezeAuthority = keypair 3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH (Solana System Program owner = regular keypair). Stellar: issuer GCQCNWT…KHZR is a single-key account. All three chains show Brale-controlled single-EOA/keypair issuer model consistent with documented permissioned mint/redeem.
